name: Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official annual deadline available; Fall 2027 date not explicitly confirmed. Department legacy TOEFL 100 is retained beside current central new-scale 4.0 without inventing an equivalent higher program score.

documents: Course-by-course evaluation of all non-US institutions for final acceptance; UAB evaluation ($100) or an accepted outside evaluation

applicationFee.note: Standard international fee $60; domestic $50, with some program exceptions. Biology explicitly cannot waive the Graduate School fee. No central waiver route was established; this is not a claim that every Graduate School exception is prohibited.

english.note: Department thresholds stricter than central IELTS 6.5/DET 120. Central scores within 2 years of application; MyBest/IELTS One Skill Retake accepted. Possible exemption: US degree with GPA 3 or listed-country citizenship; no blanket foreign English-medium exemption.

requirements.note: Biological-science undergraduate degree, A–B biology scholarship, 2 semesters each organic chemistry/physics, calculus. No program-specific GPA cutoff; mentor acceptance required but prior approval not needed to apply. No rotations. Research publications not required. International applicants must establish equivalent four-year US bachelor’s preparation; original-language degree/transcript documents and English translations are required unless an approved evaluation substitutes for translations.

funding.note: Competitive TA/RA; mentor funding required for acceptance, but no stipend/coverage promise stated. No separate funding application. RAs depend on mentor resources.
